campaigns.title: I screened 1,200 tech resumes this year. 80% make these 3 fatal mistakes in their first 5 bullet points.
campaigns.body:
Over the past 12 months, I've analyzed over a thousand developer and tech resumes.

Here is the brutal truth why so many qualified engineers are getting zero callbacks right now:

1. You write 'Responsible for X' instead of quantified results. Recruiters don't care what you were 'supposed' to do. They care what actually moved.
2. Missing the Google XYZ formula: 'Accomplished [X] as measured by [Y] by doing [Z]'.
3. Formatting that breaks Taleo, Workday, and Greenhouse ATS parsing algorithms.

To prove it, I built a free tool that runs your resume through the exact ATS scoring filters and roasts your weak verbs: https://resume-roast-ai-xi.vercel.app

Drop your target role below and I'll review a few in the comments.

campaigns.title: How to turn a 30% callback resume into an 85% callback machine 🧵
campaigns.body:
90% of job seekers are getting rejected by automated software before a human ever reads their resume.

Here are 5 bullet point transformations that landed $150k+ offers (and the tool to do it automatically):

❌ Bad: 'Worked on backend APIs and fixed system bugs.'
✅ Elite: 'Architected 14+ low-latency microservice endpoints in Go, reducing P99 latency by 42% under 10k RPS.'

❌ Bad: 'Assisted with database management.'
✅ Elite: 'Optimized index execution plans, cutting database CPU load by 35% and saving $4,200/mo in AWS spend.'

Want to know your resume's brutal ATS score in 5 seconds? Check it here: https://resume-roast-ai-xi.vercel.app
